verdict.rationale: An official community chatroom, such as a Discord, is a fair ecosystem question for a web framework, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an official chatroom or a real-time community channel. The only community reference is a user calling the community 'friendly' (angular-comm-3), which is not an official chat channel.

support.subject: As a developer, I can join an official community chatroom to get help and connect with other framework users
